selection_rule: Retain original families and counts; replace two critical and two combined cases by independently certified low-temperature, finely anisotropic materials on which the actual successful fresh solver exceeds 12 CPU seconds by at least a factor of three in extended measurements.
public_baseline: Original independently authored public damped fixed-point solver; no previous fresh implementation is public.
changes_from_generation_zero: Only the four selected numerical materials, declared parameter ranges, two independent public low-temperature examples, exact private finite-sum verification implementation, and output allowance for larger arrays change. Quality, CPU/memory resources, and score thresholds are unchanged.

evidence.broader_original_and_8192_pool: Actual fresh solver passes 12/12; those cases alone do not justify a ratchet.
evidence.failure_cluster: Repeated dense patch-pair-by-frequency contractions and scale-sensitive nonlinear work at low temperature; all four fail by CPU limit, not by output shape, path, filesystem, or memory configuration.
evidence.offline_references: Two starting amplitudes, independent full signed convolution at every frequency, and independent direct sums on distributed rows. The combined-a reference also uses an independently authored eigenmode/Newton oracle.
evidence.joint_speed_quality_attainability: Unknown; offline certificates do not establish the 12-CPU-second target.
